Q955.reason: The son's statement is an excited utterance, and that exception (FRE 803(2)) applies whether or not the declarant is available, so the team note saying it requires unavailability is wrong.

Q909.reason: Plain water is the usual recommendation for cleaning the mouth, while peroxide and lemon-glycerine swabs are discouraged because they irritate or dry the mucosa, and the team note that the agent has no effect on comfort is wrong.

Q884.reason: In squint-related diplopia the outer image comes from the deviating eye and is the false image, and the note that diplopia is always central is wrong because ocular muscle and nerve palsies commonly cause it.
